explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows ondansetron hydrochloride is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 174 tablets of the 4 mg presentation at 8.3 per day for 21 days on hand and 165 tablets at 7.2 per day for 23 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 132 tablets at 8.6 per day for 15.4 days on hand and 266 tablets at 8.9 per day for 29.9 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 46 tablets at 1.6 per day for 28.6 days on hand.
The rule ranks Ascend Laboratories, LLC as the first alternate manufacturer; it is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
Aurobindo Pharma Limited and AvKARE are ranked second and third respectively, also not on the shortage list and with no placeable plant on their labels.
Check whether the current inventory coverage at each site meets internal reorder thresholds and confirm availability from the ranked alternate manufacturers.
